panels.heading: TODAY’S PASSAGE
panels.content:
**Genesis 25:19-34**

This devotional is being drafted. The full reading + reflection ships in a future writing pass.

In the meantime, open your Bible to Genesis 25:19-34 and read it slowly. Sit with one phrase that catches you. Bring it back to mind tomorrow.

panels.heading: WHY THIS PASSAGE
panels.content:
Today’s pivot: Cheap satisfaction over inheritance. The whole canon points forward — and this reading carries its own thread of that long pointing.

Christ-link: Esteeming Christ above all (Phil 3:7-8).

panels.heading: A PRAYER
panels.content: Father, when I read this passage, let me see You truly. Slow my hurry. Soften my certainty. Show me what I have missed. Through Christ, who is the substance of every shadow. Amen.
